data.summary: ddflow-orchestrator background lanes (spawned via the harness task tool) self-schedule a resume via schedule_wakeup/ddflow resume, then return a final result (turn "completed"). The scheduled resume does NOT fire after completion, so the lane never resumes: its ddflow claim lapses to INTERRUPTED and the item re-interrupts (observed: recover-a scheduled ~35m, never resumed, items re-interrupted). The lane driver assumes self-resume survives turn end, but the harness drops subagent wakeups at completion. Fix+verify: either keep the lane session alive and loop internally (never "complete" until its scope drains), or make the harness preserve a subagent wakeup after turn end; add a regression test that a lane scheduling a resume actually resumes and its claim is heartbeat-held, not lapsed.
data.title: a background orchestrator lane that schedules a resume wakeup loses it when its turn completes, so its claim lapses and re-interrupts

Fixes bug Bbc611c0165: ddflow-orchestrator background lanes (spawned via the harness task tool) self-schedule a resume via schedule_wakeup/ddflow resume, then return a final result (turn "completed"). The scheduled resume does NOT fire after completion, so the lane never resumes: its ddflow claim lapses to INTERRUPTED and the item re-interrupts (observed: recover-a scheduled ~35m, never resumed, items re-interrupted). The lane driver assumes self-resume survives turn end, but the harness drops subagent wakeups at completion. Fix+verify: either keep the lane session alive and loop internally (never "complete" until its scope drains), or make the harness preserve a subagent wakeup after turn end; add a regression test that a lane scheduling a resume actually resumes and its claim is heartbeat-held, not lapsed.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-Bbc611c0165 --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed Bbc611c0165 --regression-test <test>` first).
